FX-FILL-001.says: The settings as they start: Fill Mask 0 (None), red, opacity 100: the whole cel red, its line, skin and shadow alike, the soft left column half red and half see-through as it was, the empty border still empty.

FX-FILL-002.says: Fill Mask 1, a box from (2, 2) to (13, 7) of mode None: red inside the box, the cel as it was outside it.

FX-FILL-003.says: FX-FILL-002 with Invert: red outside the box, the cel inside it.

FX-FILL-004.says: FX-FILL-002 at opacity 50: half way to red inside the box.

FX-FILL-005.says: Horizontal Feather 4: the box's left and right edges soften over about two pixels each side, its top and bottom stay sharp.

FX-FILL-006.says: Vertical Feather 4: the top and bottom soften, the sides stay sharp.

FX-FILL-007.says: Horizontal Feather 3 and Vertical Feather 6: soft both ways, more down than across.

FX-FILL-008.says: Both feathers 4 with Invert: the soft band turned over with the rest.

FX-FILL-009.says: A curved mask, a circle 8 across about (8, 5): its edge pixels part red, as much as of each pixel's sixteen samples falls inside.

FX-FILL-010.says: A triangle with a sloped edge from (14, 1) to (1, 9): the pixels it crosses part red.

FX-FILL-011.says: Two masks, the box and a small box inside it, Fill Mask 2: the small box alone.

FX-FILL-012.says: Two overlapping masks, (1, 1) to (7, 6) and (5, 3) to (12, 9), All Masks on: both filled, the overlap once.

FX-FILL-013.says: The same two, All Masks on, both feathers 3: soft edges, the overlap still no redder than full.

FX-FILL-014.says: Two masks, the first switched off, All Masks on: the second alone, FX-FILL-012's right box only.

FX-FILL-015.says: The box's mask of mode Add: the cel is cut to the box first, then filled, so the box is red and the rest empty.

FX-FILL-017.says: The same blue written in capitals, #3080FF: the same.

FX-FILL-018.says: The mask's path keyed from the box at frame 0 to the box two rows lower at frame 4: the fill follows it, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-FILL-019.says: Opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the cel, frame 2 half way, frame 4 FX-FILL-002's.

FX-FILL-020.says: Horizontal Feather keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4: sharp, then softer.

FX-FILL-021.says: FX-FILL-002 moved three pixels right: the fill moves with the layer.

FX-FILL-022.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the mask is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-FILL-002's.

FX-FILL-023.says: Fill Mask 1.5: its floor, mask 1, FX-FILL-002's frame.

FX-FILL-024.says: Fill Mask 0 with Invert: nothing is filled, the cel as it was.

FX-FILL-025.says: Opacity 0: the cel as it was.

FX-FILL-026.says: A mask of two points encloses nothing: the cel as it was. Inverted, FX-FILL-027, everything is filled.

FX-FILL-027.says: The two-point mask, inverted: the whole cel red, FX-FILL-001's frame.

FX-FILL-028.says: A mask from far left of the layer to x 12, Horizontal Feather 6: the covering is worked out past the layer's edge too, so the left edge stays fully red and only the edge at x 12 softens.

FX-FILL-029.says: Opacity keyed from 40 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2, where it would pass it.

FX-FILL-030.says: Fill Mask 0 with All Masks on and two masks: All Masks wins, FX-FILL-012's frame.

FX-FILL-031.says: Fill Mask 1 with no masks at all. Nothing to fill: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-FILL-032.says: Fill Mask 3, of two. Nothing to fill: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-FILL-033.says: Fill Mask 1, switched off. Nothing to fill: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-FILL-034.says: All Masks on, every mask switched off. Nothing to fill: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-FILL-035.says: All Masks on with no masks at all. Nothing to fill: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-FILL-036.says: Fill Mask -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-037.says: Fill Mask 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-038.says: Horizontal Feather -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-039.says: Vertical Feather 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-040.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-041.says: Colour "#12345", not six hex digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-042.says: Invert "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-043.says: All Masks "maybe", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FILL-044.says: Opacity keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
